sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: How do Gauss–Bonnet corrections affect renormalized charges, thermodynamics and scalar attractor behavior of static charged AdS black holes, including extremal solutions?

sources.title: Fundamental Strings and Higher Derivative Corrections to d-Dimensional Black Holes

evidence.text: What are the leading α′ corrections to d-dimensional black holes carrying fundamental-string momentum and winding charges, and how do those corrections affect gravitational thermodynamics, entropy and mass/charge relations?

sources.title: Higher order correction to the GHS string black hole

evidence.text: What is the leading α′ correction to the extremal magnetic GHS black hole's mass-charge relation, and how can it be extracted despite field-redefinition ambiguity in the higher-derivative effective action?

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: Evaluate the Euclidean on-shell action through radial total derivatives, obtain entropy through the Gibbs–Duhem relation, and compare with Wald’s horizon Noether-charge formula.

sources.title: Fundamental Strings and Higher Derivative Corrections to d-Dimensional Black Holes

evidence.text: Solution generation uses lifting to a uniform black string, two boosts and T-duality, followed by KK reduction. At order α′, the authors use corrected T-duality rules in a Gauss-Bonnet scheme related to the string scheme by field redefinitions.

sources.title: Higher order correction to the GHS string black hole

evidence.text: Perturb the string-frame Schwarzschild-gauge functions around GHS in α̂=α′/Q². Select the stated horizon-regular branch, remove apparent pole terms by a radial coordinate transformation, impose throat behavior, and read masses from the asymptotic Einstein metric.

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: For extremal horizons, extremize the entropy function F=2π(Qe−f). For scalar solutions, integrate the radial field equations from near-horizon expansions toward the asymptotic AdS expansion.

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: Brown–York quasilocal stress tensor with Einstein and Gauss–Bonnet boundary terms and intrinsic boundary counterterms; charges are obtained using boundary Killing vectors, with energy associated with ∂/∂t.

sources.title: Fundamental Strings and Higher Derivative Corrections to d-Dimensional Black Holes

evidence.text: The Euclidean calculation uses surface gravity to fix the thermal period and boost/T-duality invariance of the action integrand to obtain the free energy. Mass and entropy follow from thermodynamic identities including charge chemical potentials.

sources.title: Corrections to extremal black holes from Iyer-Wald formalism

evidence.text: How do arbitrary perturbations change four-dimensional Kerr-Newman extremality and entropy, and when can energy conditions constrain the sign of those changes without solving the corrected metric?

sources.title: Black Hole Solutions with Electric and Magnetic Charges in Nonlinear Electrodynamic

evidence.text: How do nonlinear electromagnetic interactions modify electrically and magnetically charged black holes, including their geometry, thermodynamics, geodesics, regularity, holographic applications, and proposed quantum-gravity constraints?

sources.title: Non-vanishing of tidal Love numbers

evidence.text: Does a cubic Riemann-curvature correction generate nonzero static black-hole tidal Love numbers, and can its correction to Wald entropy yield a controlled restriction on the coupling's sign?

sources.title: Negative corrections to black hole entropy from string theory

evidence.text: Must leading higher-derivative corrections increase black-hole entropy at fixed conserved quantities when the uncorrected configuration is thermodynamically stable and the relevant Wilson coefficients arise at tree level? The paper tests this proposed positivity condition using rotating string solutions.

sources.title: Corrections to AdS$_{5}$ black hole thermodynamics from higher-derivative supergravity

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric four-derivative corrections change charged, rotating AdS5 black-hole thermodynamics, and do the corrected action and BPS entropy match the dual superconformal index?

sources.title: $\alpha'$ corrections of Reissner-Nordström black holes

evidence.text: What are the complete first-order α′ corrections to a specified non-extremal dyonic RN embedding in heterotic string theory, and what do its thermodynamics imply about proposed links between entropy shifts, extremality and the WGC?

sources.title: Black holes in Lorentz-violating gravity: Thermodynamics, geometry, and particle dynamics

evidence.text: How do nonminimal Kalb–Ramond couplings alter black-hole extremality relations, thermodynamic and photon-sphere topology, thermodynamic curvature, and massive-particle trajectories?

sources.title: On Black Hole Temperature in Horndeski Gravity

evidence.text: Can the failure of the usual Wald entropy and first-law prescription for certain Horndeski black holes be resolved through graviton propagation and a modified temperature, without adding an ad hoc scalar charge?

sources.title: Effectiveness of Weyl gravity in probing quantum corrections to AdS black holes

evidence.text: Can field redefinitions into a Weyl-tensor basis simplify leading higher-curvature corrections to rotating AdS black-hole thermodynamics, including all three curvature-squared invariants of five-dimensional minimal gauged supergravity?

sources.title: D = 5 rotating black holes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity: mass and angular momentum in extremality

evidence.text: How do perturbative quadratic-curvature corrections change the extremal mass–angular-momentum relation and entropy of five-dimensional rotating black holes, and how should extremality be approached when non-extremality is itself of the coupling's order?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric black holes with α′ corrections

evidence.text: How do first-order heterotic α′ corrections depend on the relative signs of extremal black-hole charges, and what do the corrected masses, entropies and T-duality properties imply for nonsupersymmetric branches?

sources.title: Entropy Bounds on Effective Field Theory from Rotating Dyonic Black Holes

evidence.text: What field-basis invariant constraints on four-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell EFT follow from positive classical Wald-entropy corrections for thermodynamically stable rotating dyonic black holes, and how do these constraints affect extremality and black-hole decay?

sources.title: Higher derivative corrections to Kerr black hole thermodynamics

evidence.text: How do six- and eight-derivative gravitational EFT operators change Kerr thermodynamics at first order, can those changes be obtained without the corrected metric, and when do entropy corrections have definite signs?

sources.title: Exploring String Theory Solutions: Black hole thermodynamics with $\alpha'$ corrections and type II compactifications

evidence.text: How do higher-derivative corrections and gauge freedoms affect heterotic black-hole thermodynamics, and how do source localization, membrane instabilities and integral-cohomology torsion affect type II compactifications?

sources.title: Extremalization approach to black hole thermodynamics: perturbations around higher-derivative gravities

evidence.text: Can Euclidean-action extremalization compute first-order black-hole thermodynamic corrections around known higher-derivative gravity backgrounds, retaining exact dependence on their original couplings and correctly treating AdS boundary data?

sources.title: String gravity in D=4

evidence.text: What minimal four-dimensional gravitational theory follows from heterotic string theory at first order in α′, and how does it modify neutral Kerr geometry, thermodynamics and potentially the extremal spin bound?

sources.title: Duality-invariant higher-derivative corrections to charged stringy black holes

evidence.text: How do duality-invariant higher-derivative terms change the extremal charge-to-mass ratio and attractor entropy of two-dimensional charged heterotic black holes, and what interpretation is possible in relation to weak gravity?

sources.title: Leading higher-derivative corrections to Kerr geometry

evidence.text: What effective theory captures the leading higher-derivative deformations of four-dimensional vacuum GR black holes, including scalar-controlled couplings, and how do its rotating solutions modify Kerr horizon geometry, thermodynamic quantities, photon rings and scalar profiles?

sources.title: Black Hole Thermodynamic Ensembles, Euclidean Action and Legendre Transformation

evidence.text: Which black-hole ensembles can be obtained consistently by Legendre-transforming the Euclidean on-shell action, and how can geometric charges and Chern-Simons terms be accommodated while preserving agreement with the variational principle and Wald first law?

sources.title: Higher-Derivative Corrections to Entropy and the Weak Gravity Conjecture in Anti-de Sitter Space

evidence.text: How do four-derivative interactions change AdS-Reissner-Nordström extremality and microcanonical entropy, and what Wilson-coefficient constraints follow if entropy corrections are positive for thermodynamically stable black holes?

sources.title: Kerr-Newman Black Holes with String Corrections

evidence.text: Do Kerr-Newman and more general Einstein-Maxwell solutions survive a supersymmetric four-derivative correction, and can their corrected entropy be controlled continuously from BPS to Schwarzschild limits?

sources.title: Derivative corrections to extremal black holes with moduli

evidence.text: How do higher-derivative operators change the fixed-charge mass, entropy and long-range self-force of large extremal black holes with moduli, and are the three corrections correlated in ways relevant to the WGC and RFC?

sources.title: First order corrections to black hole thermodynamics: A simple approach enhanced

evidence.text: How can first-order higher-derivative corrections to black-hole thermodynamics be obtained without solving the perturbed metric when the correction changes the effective AdS cosmological constant?

sources.title: On the extremality bound of stringy black holes

evidence.text: How do first-order heterotic α′ corrections change the extremal charge-to-mass ratio of explicitly embedded, nonsupersymmetric dyonic black holes, and do those changes track corrections to Wald entropy?

sources.title: Electromagnetic Quasitopological Gravities

evidence.text: Can nonminimal curvature–electromagnetic couplings extend generalized quasitopological gravity while retaining single-function charged spherical solutions, tractable thermodynamics, and nonperturbative information about regularity and extremality?

sources.title: Higher-Curvature Gravity, Black Holes and Holography

evidence.text: Which higher-curvature gravities have tractable linearized spectra and black holes, how do their corrections affect four-dimensional black-hole thermodynamics, and what CFT information can their AdS solutions reveal?

sources.title: Quadratic curvature correction and its breakdown to thermodynamics of rotating black holes

evidence.text: What are the leading quadratic-curvature corrections to Myers–Perry thermodynamics in different ensembles, where do they diverge, and do these divergences necessarily survive beyond perturbation theory?

sources.title: Higher Derivative Corrections to R-charged Black Holes: Boundary Counterterms and the Mass-Charge Relation

evidence.text: Can curvature-squared Einstein–Maxwell theory be holographically renormalized with a perturbatively well-defined variational principle, and how do its corrections affect charged black-hole thermodynamics, extremal mass/charge ratios and proposed weak-gravity/viscosity connections?

sources.title: T-duality equivalences beyond string theory

evidence.text: Does corrected T-duality preserve non-extremal black-hole horizons, entropy and temperature throughout a two-parameter family of four-derivative theories, including parameter choices without a known string-theory origin?

sources.title: Black Hole Thermodynamic Ensembles, Euclidean Action and Legendre Transformation

evidence.text: Uses circle reduction, differential forms, Hodge duals and integrations by parts to construct lower-dimensional gauge-invariant actions and lift Legendre terms. Explicit action integrals use Stokes' theorem, including horizon and angular-boundary contributions.

sources.title: On Black Hole Temperature in Horndeski Gravity

evidence.text: A decomposition along constant-φ hypersurfaces separates intrinsic curvature and extrinsic-curvature terms. The authors use their coefficients as a shortcut to the direction-dependent graviton speeds, rather than presenting a full linearized perturbation analysis.

sources.title: First order corrections to black hole thermodynamics: A simple approach enhanced

sources.title: First order corrections to black hole thermodynamics: A simple approach enhanced

evidence.text: Regularize AdS integrals by subtracting pure AdS, matching proper Euclidean time periodicity at a radial cutoff before removing the cutoff. Extract thermodynamic quantities by differentiating the resulting free energy and performing ensemble Legendre transformations.
